Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AON.
We delivered record revenue of $22.1 billion this quarter, representing 9% year-over-year growth.
Revenue guidance of $22.1 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2019.
Our cloud segment grew 9% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 9% to 24% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. We generated $11.1 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
